page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Signature "B 4" at foot centre. Catchword at foot right. No marginal notes. Show-through and the neighbouring page's edge at the left and right are not transcribed.

main_text.p: in argumentum poenitentiae meae, sæpe plurimo cum dolore, coram Deo & hominibus testatus sum, ut vitium pravæFragilitatis, quâ me cum ostendi, in quem plus metus hominum, quam Dei timor pollebat: cujus Nomi-ne[?] & Loco in terris indignus est, qui actu tam insignis injustitiæ, quem nulla possunt penfare vel Publica commoda, damnum aliquod Politicum declinat.
Misera sane transactio! accepta in conscientiis plaga, mederi malis Rei-publicæ, & excitatâ in pectore nostro tempestate, æstus populares, & querelas compescere.

Nec fefellit eventus Dei justitiam; & quæ consecuta sunt tristissima satis mundo declarârunt, quam fallax est illud satius unum interire vel innoxium, quam populi of-fensam, vel ruinam accersere. Nihil enim mihi atrocius evenisset, si asserta Straffordii Innocentia, & justissimis Conscientiæ dictatis obtemperans, legem illam Damnatoriam obfirmare recusassem, quàm quæ postea minore cum solatio perpessus sum Ipse, & Populus meus, postquam ingratis quorundam obtestationibus tam crudelem gratiam indulsissem. Quin & illud etiam observavi, eos qui Authores mihi erant suis consiliis, ut sententiam illam ratam facerem, nullam aliam mercedem Gratiosi Officii, quàm Direptiones, Vexationes, & omne genus contumeliæ ab illo ipso, quem captabant populo retulisse: illo solum minimè omnium læso qui id sedulò

page.notes: Long s (s) read as s throughout. Greek running head: the final letter looks like Latin H in print; transcribed as Greek Eta. Printed space missing in "pravæFragilitatis" (kept as printed). "Nomi-ne" at line end is partly unclear. Catchword at foot right is hard to read; it is the first word of the next page and is marked [?]. Left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and right edge shows marks, not transcribed.
